A certain mass of ideal gas is sealed within a beverage bottle. At a temperature of $t=27^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, the pressure is $p= 1.050 \times 10^{5}\mathrm{{Pa}}$.

1. What is the gas pressure when the temperature is $t^{\prime}=37^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$?
2. Maintaining the temperature constant, the gas is compressed until its pressure is the same as in (1); what is the ratio of the new gas volume to the original volume?

Reasoning calculation: It is known that the initial pressure p = 1.050 × 10^5 Pa, and the temperature t = 27°C, so the thermodynamic temperature T = 27 + 273 = 300 K. raw_record.question_text:
A certain mass of ideal gas is sealed within a beverage bottle. At a temperature of $t=27^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, the pressure is $p=1.050 \times 10^{5}\mathrm{Pa}$.

1. What is the gas pressure when the temperature is $t'=37^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$?
2. Maintaining the temperature constant, the gas is compressed until its pressure is the same as in (1); what is the ratio of the new gas volume to the original volume?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image: it shows a capped beverage bottle, supporting the interpretation that the gas amount is sealed and, for the first part, the bottle volume is unchanged; no numerical values are read from the image. From the text, read the initial pressure p = 1.050 × 10^5 Pa, initial temperature t = 27°C, and new temperature t' = 37°C. Convert temperatures to kelvin: T = 300 K and T' = 310 K. For the sealed gas at fixed volume and fixed amount, use Gay-Lussac's law p/T = constant, so p' = p(T'/T) = 1.050 × 10^5 × 310/300 = 1.085 × 10^5 Pa. For the second part, read from the text that the temperature is held constant while the gas is compressed until its pressure equals the pressure found in part (1). Use Boyle's law pV = constant at constant temperature: pV = p'V_new, hence V_new/V = p/p' = 1.050/1.085 ≈ 0.97.

1. 封闭气体在体积和物质的量不变时，满足 p/T = 常量，因此 p' = p × T'/T = 1.050 × 10^5 × 310/300 = 1.085 × 10^5 Pa。

2. 保持温度不变并压缩气体，满足玻意耳定律 pV = p'V_new。因此 V_new/V = p/p' = 1.050/1.085 ≈ 0.97。所以新体积约为原体积的 0.97 倍。
